plain: Lyn Buchanan, a former US Army sergeant, tells podcast host Jesse Michels that he was once taken aboard a UFO, and in one version he says it happened from a country church house in East Texas in the mid 1960s. He says the alien pilot brought him up front, let him try the controls, and that he learned how to fly it. He adds that they landed somewhere that was not Earth, which, if true, would mean a human had flown a non-human craft to another world.
